$description: What the uFSM editor paints, as aliases to palette roles a theme defines (format: Design Tokens 2025.10). A theme's resolver lists this file first and then defines every role referenced here: palette.bg0 (cards, the sheet, state fill), bgDeep (behind the sheet, fields, text on accents), bgGrid (sheet grid dots), bg1, bg2 (raised and hover backgrounds, borders), fg1 (text), fg4 (secondary text, diagram lines), gray, red, green, yellow, blue, purple, aqua, orange (accents), chrome (window background around the cards), edge (card edges) and shadow (menus). A theme may also override any token below. ui.* become CSS custom properties (ui.card-edge -> --card-edge, plus --card-edge-rgb as 'r g b' for alpha), syntax.* become --syntax-*, canvas.* are the diagram colors.

bg-dark.$description: Editor area, fields, active tab; text on accent backgrounds

chrome.$description: Title bar, status bar and the gaps between the cards

card.$description: Explorer, editor and panel cards; menus

close-hover.$description: Window close button under the pointer (Windows convention)

ink.$description: Lines, arrows and text of the diagram

selection.$description: Selection, handles, tool previews, enclosing rubber band

touching.$description: Rubber band that selects what it touches

ok.$description: A transition target that would be accepted

badge-mark.$description: The exclamation mark on a badge

active.$description: Simulator: active states (outline, a faint fill for the innermost) and the last step's transitions

would.$description: Simulator: transitions the hovered event would take

note.$description: Notes, group frames and arrows: documentation that is not part of the machine
